messages:
diane: Deploy bot reports apac-west-1 post-deploy embedding synthetic spike. p95 went from ~120ms to ~850ms, 5xx ~6.2%. Canary traffic at 2% only. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/reports/2142

deploy-bot: POST-DEPLOY CHECKS: canary=2% ok, healthchecks=OK, synth/embed-checker=FAILED in apac-west-1 (5xx rate 6.2%). Logs: /ops/smoke/logs/2142

smoke-bot: synthetic run id 2142
- target: embed-checker
- image: inference-service:2026-03-20-128
- error: model_sent_incompatible_shard
- sample err: \"inference error: model shard mismatch\"

alex: Is apac running the new sharded model? I remember the shard migration finished last night but maybe routing didn't update everywhere.

ben: Confirmed: new image + shard map pushed ~01:12 UTC. My guess is partial dataplane state: some pods have new shard map, others still reference old. Synths hitting the mismatch.

cory: Quick mitigation: pin apac-west-1 traffic to previous stable model v1.4.2 while we investigate. We can annotate the router to force version.

ben: Command to pin (one-off):
  kubectl -n inference annotate svc/inference routing-version=1.4.2 --overwrite

ben: +1 to pin. Also pause global rollout until we validate apac. @deploy-bot please pause.

deploy-bot: Pausing rollout at 2% globally. Draining canary traffic from new release in apac-west-1.

diane: Ben, can you run smoke probes from a few apac nodes after the pin? Target: p95 < 200ms and 5xx < 0.5% before we consider resuming.

ben: Running quick checks from apac-1, apac-3, apac-5. Will paste results in ~10m.

(10m later)

ben: apac-1: p95 180ms, 5xx 0.1%
apac-3: p95 190ms, 5xx 0.0%
apac-5: p95 210ms, 5xx 0.2% (borderline high p95 on apac-5)

alex: Apac-5 spike might be a noisy host; still better than the shard-mismatch failures. I'd prefer to rollback the sharded image in apac entirely and re-run the migration in a controlled canary cluster.

cory: Agreed. Proposed plan: keep routing pin in place, rollback model image tag in apac to v1.4.2, revert shard-mapping push for apac, then re-run migration on a single canary pod later. I'll open a rollback PR and schedule a short window now.

diane: Do it. Also create an incident record: \"apac-embed-shard-mismatch\" and assign to eng-ml for the postmortem. Include the synth logs and the shard map diff.

ben: PR created: https://git.internal/repo/pull/7824 — rollback sharded migration for apac region

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for apac-west-1 model image to v1.4.2. Smoke probes set to run every 2m for 30m. Will report results.

alex: Notifying support to watch for customer impact and updating internal release notes: \"Hold: APAC embed migration deferred\".

cory: Adding runbook checklist: 1) set routing pin 2) verify synth p95/5xx thresholds 3) rollback tag if thresholds breach 4) reattempt migration on single canary 5) escalate if unstable.

diane: Reconvene in 35m to review. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ben: ack

cory: ack :white_check_mark:

smoke-bot: Final synth summary after pin+rollback: p95 median 185ms, 5xx 0.15% across probes in apac-west-1. Canary marked STABLE in apac with v1.4.2.

diane: Closing thread for now. We'll follow up with a short postmortem and migration checklist updates.
